get.description: Lists admin users for a selected Poly Lens tenant.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Prefilled GraphQL document for the tenant-admins query. Keep visible due safety restrictions on hiding new privileged defaults.

schema.description: Prefilled GraphQL document for the tenant-admins query. Keep visible due safety restrictions on hiding new privileged defaults.
schema.default: query ListTenantAdmins($params: UserSearchParams!) { users(params: $params) { edges { node { user_id email email_verified last_ip logins_count last_login } } } }
